title: Release sprint gap analysis and action lattice
content:
Meeting: Release Engineering weekly sync — sprint-gap analysis / action lattice
Date: 2025-02-04 10:00 PT
Attendees: Aisha (owner), Diego, Priya, Nora, Sam (oncall, 2pm-10pm), Tessa (SRE), optional: Jonah (product)
Absentees noted in thread: Aaron (vacation)

Purpose and quick summary:
- Quick diagnostic of the last two release trains (v1.38 / v1.39), identify capacity and process gaps that produced the proliferation of mid-cycle hotfixes.
- Produce prioritized, owner-assigned action lattice (small, testable remediations) for next 30/60/90 days.
- Decide on temporary cadence adjustment for the next two cycles if required.

High-level findings (what we observed):
1) Increased hotfix churn after v1.38 canary: 6 hotfix PRs opened within 48h, 3 required rollback of dependent routing trees. Root causes: a) insufficient integration test coverage around model-variant routing (RELENG-3421), b) sudden latency degradation under burst loads in us-west-2 during canary window.
2) Bottleneck: staging capacity for performance smoke tests is 40% lower than production baseline during our weekly windows (we are running on shared spot capacity, see notes). This increases false negatives/positives and delays signoff.
3) Oncall blur: escalation playbooks are accurate but ownership handoff during cross-team rotations ambiguous — several incidents had 'waiting for infra ticket' pauses.
4) Release train calendar: overlapping team vacations + aggressive feature gates caused squeeze windows; historically we buffer 2 business days between gateway freeze and canary start, but last two cycles reduced to 1 day.

Quantified metrics (quick):
- Canary-to-hotfix delta (v1.38): first hotfix opened 6h after canary start.
- Median P95 token latency spike during canary: +18% in us-west-2 (baseline 120ms -> 142ms).
- Staging perf pool capacity: 12 GPUs (equiv); required peak for test sim: 20 GPUs.
- Time-to-fix (hotfix median): 4.2 hours from detection to merged rollback.

Immediate tactical decisions (consensus):
- Increase staging perf capacity for the next two canary windows by borrowing 8 GPUs from Dedicated dev pool (owner: Priya). Target: replicate production peak for 75% of request distribution. Deadline: 2025-02-07 EOD.
- Enforce a minimum 48h buffer between final code freeze and canary start for next two trains (owner: Aisha, coordinate with Product). Rationale: gives infra/QA time to finish extended smoke tests.
- Hotfix triage channel protocol update: require a triage ticket (RELENG-3478) linked within 15 minutes of detection; if no owner assigned within 30 minutes, oncall escalates to SRE lead. (owner: Nora).

Action lattice (structured, prioritized, testable items):
- A1 (High, <7d): Staging perf bump — allocate +8 GPUs and run full perf suite. Success metric: replicate p95 behavior within 10% of prod. Owner: Priya. Blockers: budget approval from infra (Diego to ping infra slack #infra-billing).
- A2 (High, <14d): Add synthetic burst test to CI that mimics 95th-percentile request patterns for 5m sustained. Hook to gating: fail release if p95 increases >12%. Owner: Diego + SRE test infra. Linked PR: GH PR #256.
- B1 (Medium, <30d): Routing integration tests — expand integration suite to cover model-variant fallback and KV cache warm paths. Draft test plan: Priya + Eng-Serving. Owner: Priya.
- B2 (Medium, <30d): Oncall handoff checklist (short doc) to be embedded in calendar invites and runbook. Owner: Nora.
- C1 (Low, <60d): Release cadence proposal — move to three-week train trial (trial runs for next 2 cycles), with retrospective afterwards. Owner: Aisha + Product liaison Jonah. Decision: defer final accept until after perf validation.

Open questions and unknowns (notes-to-self style):
- How many customers are pinned to older routing trees that could be affected by rollback? Need quick query (analytics) to scope blast radius. (TODO: Diego to request run).
- Cost impact of staging perf bump: estimate needed before commit. (Diego).
- Will Dedicated dev pool tolerate borrowing GPUs? Ops pre-approve? (Diego -> ops).

Risks and mitigation matrix (short):
- Risk: Staging capacity increases still not representative -> False negatives remain. Mitigation: run subset of production traffic replay (sanitized) in perf window. Owner: Priya.
- Risk: Longer freeze delays feature delivery -> Product pushback. Mitigation: A/B communicate tradeoffs and commit to 1 extra week of feature runway in next roadmap. Owner: Aisha + Jonah.
- Risk: Hotfix ticket latency causes poor SLA -> enforce 15m triage rule and weekly audit. Owner: Nora.

Notes from SRE (Tessa):
- Observed KV cache warmup variance correlates with model-sharding changes in v1.38. Recommend adding warmup phase to canary (gradual ramp over 10 minutes).
- Suggest sunset of one noisy metric (old attention-mem) from alerting to reduce noise; will propose PR to monitoring.

Action items (owner, due):
- Priya: allocate +8 staging GPUs and run perf suite; post results to this doc (due 2025-02-07).
- Diego: prepare cost estimate and get ops pre-approval for temporary GPU borrow (due 2025-02-06).
- Nora: update hotfix triage protocol message and create RELENG-3478 epic linking triage playbooks (due 2025-02-05).
- Aisha: announce temporary 48h freeze buffer to Product and include in release calendar (due 2025-02-05).
- Tessa: add canary warmup steps to canary-runbook draft and open monitoring PR (due 2025-02-09).

Follow-ups / Next sync:
- Quick sync Tuesday 2025-02-06 09:30 PT to review Priya and Diego's updates (15m).
- Full release-engineering retro on 2025-02-13 to decide on cadence trial.

Misc notes / raw snippets captured in meeting:
- "If we keep shrinking the buffer to hit feature dates we build fragility." — Jonah (prod).
- Slack thread: #release-ops: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CE74K2K1P/p1675400000000
- Quick grep query to run: 'model-routing-varying-kv-warm OR shard-change' across logs for last 14 days (Diego).

Appendix: short checklist for next canary window (to paste into release calendar):
- Final freeze (t-48h) confirmation: Engineering lead ack, QA ack, Infra ack.
- Staging perf capacity check (Priya) + smoke-run results link.
- Canary warmup steps added to job (SRE).
- Oncall triage ticket template ready and pinned to channel.
- Rollback playbook quick test (owner runs dry-run on canary)

End of notes.

Draft status notes: this doc is a working artifact; will update as owners post results. Expect edits from Diego/Priya before 2025-02-06 meeting.

-- Aisha
